project.name: A.N ERP
project.description: نظام تخطيط وإدارة موارد المؤسسات المتكامل

defects.title: approveAndPostStockCount lacks shared transaction between General Ledger and Stock Movements
defects.impact: If recordStockMovement fails after journal post, GL remains altered while inventory balances remain unadjusted without automatic rollback or outbox retry.
defects.recommendation: Wrap stock adjustments and GL journal creation into an atomic transaction or register under PENDING_RETRY outbox.

defects.title: returnStock ignores PostingEngine.postEntry return result and lacks PENDING_RETRY outbox
defects.impact: If reversal journal fails to post, returnStock still returns success:true, leaving stock deducted/added without corresponding GL entry.
defects.recommendation: Check postEntry return result and attach journalStatus PENDING_RETRY on failure.

defects.title: createGoodsReceipt TOCTOU race condition on open PO line quantity under concurrent requests
defects.impact: Two concurrent receipts for the same PO line can both pass remaining quantity validation before row lock.
defects.recommendation: Perform PO line quantity check inside a locked transaction (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE).

defects.title: Absence of formal version-controlled migration runner with checksum tracking
defects.impact: Schema relies on programmatic CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and ALTER TABLE statements on startup rather than dedicated migration files.
defects.recommendation: Implement structured migration tracking table with incremental version numbers and checksums.
